quote: We further evaluate CAMERO on the Transformer-base NMT model using widely used IWSLT and WMT datasets.
We further evaluate CAMERO on the Transformer-base NMT model using widely used IWSLT and WMT datasets. Specifically, we adopt IWSLT'14 En↔De, IWSLT'16 En↔Fr and WMT'14 En↔De.
CAMERO also achieves significant improvements in neural machine translation on both low-resource and high-resource language pairs.
